external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer. They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and accesses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, which handles invoices, payment pages, PDF requests, and database access.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.
processes.notes: The app uses one database account for all companies and one service credential to fetch PDFs from the bucket.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time, reads the invoice from the tenant database and writes the PDF to the PDF bucket
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by the job.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: The shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security and the app connects with one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: The queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state where the queue runs or how it is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: The shared bucket where the PDF renderer writes invoice PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: Customer users use the billing app, including signing in and working with invoices.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, credentials, and session cookie

data_flows.name: access tenant database
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and writes tenant data in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app saves every field received from the invoice edit form.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and invoice edits

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue. The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes an invoice PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice link and opens the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, bank details, and invoice number

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: The billing app sends the payer an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

data_flows.name: sign in console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console using their account and a one-time code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code.

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company tenant
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant boundary associated with a customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud-platform zone containing the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The render queue holds confidential data because its jobs carry company IDs and invoice numbers that identify invoice records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that render jobs carry a company ID and an invoice number.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket holds confidential data because it stores invoice PDFs containing invoice and bank-detail information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the renderer writes invoice PDFs to the PDF bucket, and the payment page displays invoices and bank details.
